purpose: Determine whether the published PANGAEA Adelie colony pixels can be linked back to modern USGS Landsat Collection-2 Level-1 Landsat-7 source scenes before any classifier performance or penguin demographic outcome is evaluated.

crosswalk_rule.query_geometry: representative published pixel coordinate from each source file
match_priority: LANDSAT_7 item with matching WRS path, WRS row and acquisition date
LANDSAT_7 item on exact date whose item identifier contains the parsed path/row token

prohibited: dropping source scenes because their published d-values are inconvenient
next_gate_if_passed: Freeze a deterministic source-scene/pixel subsample and reproduce published d-values from Collection-2 Level-1 TOA reflectance.
stop_rule: Do not loosen crosswalk thresholds after classifier discrepancies or demographic outcomes are observed.
